svg.text: How the electrodes connect to the computer
Start at the left. Each channel has a + and − electrode wire; the ADS1296 converts them to digital readings.

_N means the signal is active when LOW.
J1: regulated 5 V → power circuit → VSYS → A1 socket 1
LP5907 (U2) → analog 3.3 V (AVDD) → ADS1296 + protection ICs
A1 socket 3 → digital 3.3 V (3V3_D) → ADS1296 digital supply
Tiny FPC → kit USB-C adapter → PC / ML
Power, pull resistors and capacitors: picture 02
Filled dots are connections. Matching net names also connect. NC = leave unconnected. Protection branch details are expanded in picture 03.
